evidence.text: Reason for referral: Evaluation of breathlessness on exertion.

Findings: Sinus bradycardia at 56 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 198 ms, QRS 97 ms, QTc 453
ms.
Impression: Sinus bradycardia, otherwise normal tracing.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
30%. Grade 1 diasttolic dysfunction. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Severely reduced left ventricular systolic function.

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 136 mmol/L
Potassium: 5.1 mmol/L (H)
Chloride: 99 mmol/L
CO2: 24 mmol/L
BUN: 15 mg/dL
Creatinine: 1.5 mg/dL (H)
Glucose: 121 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 9.0 mg/dL

Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Amlodipine 5 mg by mouth once daily

EXAM:

Neck: no carotid bruits.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, no murmurs or gallops.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
Extremities: no peripheral edema.
